stories.headline: Georgia-Pacific invests $150 million to modernize Palatka tissue production
stories.body: Georgia-Pacific has begun an approximately US$150 million rebuild of a paper machine at its Palatka, Florida, mill. The company’s October 29 announcement expects completion in the second quarter of 2028.

stories.headline: New York farm study tests the costs and performance of planting trees in pasture
stories.body: A new multi-year study is testing tree planting on six working New York cattle farms. Researchers will compare three silvopasture designs, combining trees, forage and livestock, under Northeast conditions.
stories.region: NORTHEAST — NEW YORK / OCTOBER 30 RESEARCH LAUNCH

stories.headline: Oil Mountain aspen work seeks proposals by Tuesday afternoon
stories.body: The National Forest Foundation’s current Oil Mountain solicitation closes November 3 at 5 p.m. Mountain Standard Time. It seeks forestry services in the Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison National Forests.

stories.headline: New Brunswick bids for timberlands as Nackawic mill idling approaches
stories.body: New Brunswick has submitted a bid for private timberlands supplying the AV Nackawic pulp mill, which is scheduled to idle November 4. Natural Resources Minister John Herron said the bid aims to retain wood supply for future regional…
stories.region: CANADA — NEW BRUNSWICK / TIMBERLAND AND MILL OPTIONS

featuredResource.title: Harvesting Woody Biomass: A Small Business Guide
featuredResource.description: This free book helps logging businesses evaluate whether biomass production fits their operations and markets. It covers harvesting systems, financial calculations and business planning, including an example expansion plan.
